title: Every quantity that crossed zero between backends states its resolution
note: D-2026-98. QR1-QR5: the energy ledger's floor is the energy its balance leaves unexplained, in magnitude, plus the rounding bound of its sums, and the cumulative class is judged against the cumulative floor. QR6: each mode's sample densities are classified by their own solve. QR7: a relative change is judged against the tightest tolerance of the solves compared. QR8-QR16: bindings are quantity by quantity, reconciled against the committed artefacts.

mutations.name: QR1_the_floor_ignores_the_unexplained_energy
mutations.rationale: the ledger's floor is only the rounding of its sums, and a cancellation below the closure residual reads as resolved

mutations.name: QR2_the_floor_is_signed
mutations.rationale: a negative residual makes a negative floor

mutations.name: QR3_unexplained_energy_cancels
mutations.rationale: signed residuals cancel in the floor, so a ledger whose phases disagree in opposite directions claims to resolve everything

mutations.name: QR4_the_cumulative_class_uses_the_phase_floor
mutations.rationale: the cumulative dU is judged against one phase's closure, not the ledger's

mutations.name: QR5_no_rounding_bound
mutations.rationale: a closure that lands on exactly zero has a zero floor

mutations.name: QR6_mode_C_classified_by_mode_B
mutations.rationale: Mode C's sample densities are classified by Mode B's solve

mutations.name: QR7_the_rel_change_floor_is_the_loosest
mutations.find: floor = min(float(r) for r in rtols)
mutations.replace: floor = max(float(r) for r in rtols)
mutations.rationale: a change the tighter solve resolves is absorbed by the looser one's tolerance

mutations.name: QR8_a_pattern_binds_without_the_member
mutations.rationale: every member of an object is bound to the pattern, not to its own class

mutations.name: QR9_any_binding_in_the_file_will_do
mutations.replace:
return table[pattern][:-1] + last
    return next(iter(table.values()), None)
mutations.rationale: the file-level proxy: a quantity with no binding borrows another's

mutations.name: QR10_a_carrier_need_not_be_a_class
mutations.rationale: a JSON carrier holding anything is accepted

mutations.name: QR11_parallel_members_need_not_match
mutations.rationale: a species with no class in the parallel object passes

mutations.name: QR13_a_row_carrier_need_not_be_a_class
mutations.rationale: a long table's carrier row may hold anything

mutations.name: QR14_a_path_is_split_not_parsed
mutations.find:
if m.start() != pos:
            raise ValueError(f"not a leaf path: {path!r}")
mutations.replace:
if False:
            raise ValueError(f"not a leaf path: {path!r}")
mutations.rationale: a malformed path parses as something

mutations.name: QR15_a_bound_quantity_need_not_be_a_number
mutations.rationale: a binding on a label passes as a quantity

mutations.name: QR16_a_pattern_may_bind_a_leaf
mutations.rationale: a pattern bound to one leaf is accepted
